coverage: title + tagline + job relevance + 8 outcomes + 10 theory code/output blocks + 11 callouts + 3 figures

top_level.current_content: comparación honesta que conserva el baseline determinista y demuestra cuándo el ML agrega —o no agrega— valor
top_level.justification: The intended gate is excellent; findings F09-F14/F43 show that the source does not yet execute it, which is not a reason to weaken the tagline.

top_level.current_content: En banca, fintech y ops de riesgo en LatAm (mesas de revisión de alertas en Lima o Arequipa), un workbench serio —la mesa de trabajo del analista— no reemplaza reglas claras por un modelo opaco sin un baseline (línea base determinista que todo modelo debe superar). Aquí aprendes a documentar ese baseline, los costos de FP/FN (falsos positivos y falsos negativos) y a probar si un modelo supervisado mejora la prioridad de revisión. Si no gana al dummy, se loguea igual y no se promueve complejidad inútil; la predicción de cola nunca es etiqueta de fraude.
top_level.improved_content: En banca, fintech y operaciones de riesgo en LatAm, un workbench serio no reemplaza una regla simple por un modelo más complejo sin demostrar valor incremental. Aquí documentas dos anclas antes del candidato: un dummy ajustado solo con train y una regla versionada; después evalúas ambos y el modelo sobre las mismas filas, con la misma métrica y la misma función de costo cuando FP/FN son asimétricos. Un experimento que pierde se conserva en el log, pero no se promociona si no supera al mejor baseline bajo el objetivo predeclarado o si falla el feature-set, el split o la trazabilidad. El score solo prioriza una cola humana; nunca es una etiqueta de fraude.
top_level.justification: The current wording makes beating dummy sound like the decisive promotion condition even though the section itself documents a rule baseline that can be stronger.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Definir unidad de scoring, target observable y horizonte temporal
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Definir unidad de scoring, evento/target observable con provenance de etiquetado, origen y horizonte; validar consistencia y madurez completa del outcome antes de entrenar.
learning_outcomes.justification: Observable, valid and mature labels are separate requirements not currently demonstrated.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Fijar baseline de regla y dummy majority con costo FP/FN
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Ajustar el dummy solo con train, congelar una regla simple con provenance de umbral y comparar dummy, regla y candidato sobre el mismo holdout con la misma métrica y costo FP/FN.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current dummy leaks validation labels and cost is not symmetric across alternatives.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Calcular sigmoid, predicción umbralada y documentar L2 (penalty + l2_sq diagnóstico)
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Ajustar una regresión logística regularizada dentro del pipeline de train, registrar la configuración L2 compatible con la versión fijada de scikit-learn y evaluar probabilidades finitas/estables y predicciones congeladas en validación.
learning_outcomes.justification: Calculating sigmoid with invented weights is not fitting supervised logistic regression.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Interpretar coeficientes escalados sin claim causal
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Interpretar coeficientes unidos a su feature-set, escala, modelo y fold; comparar magnitudes solo cuando la escala es compatible y mantener explícitamente que la asociación del modelo no demuestra causalidad, parentesco ni fraude.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current scaled/causal flags are handwritten rather than derived from model/feature metadata.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Aplicar stumps controlados y voto mayoritario frente al dummy y a la regla
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Ajustar un stump y los candidatos de Random Forest/boosting exigidos por el roadmap con parámetros acotados; evaluarlos sobre el mismo holdout frente al dummy, la regla y la logística.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current code does not train a tree and explicitly omits the required RF/boosting practice.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Detectar overfit por gap train−valid (diagnóstico de lab) y fijar seed reproducible
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Usar la brecha train−valid como señal de sobreajuste dentro de una selección de complejidad reproducible, registrando seed, datos, split, feature-set, código, versiones y parámetros; congelar la configuración antes del test final.
learning_outcomes.justification: Seed alone is not reproducibility and no depth candidates are actually selected.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Registrar runs mínimos (params, metrics, beats_dummy/beats_rule) aunque pierdan al baseline
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Registrar cada run —gane o pierda— con feature-set, datos/split, pipeline/modelo y versiones, params/seed, predicciones o artefacto trazable, métricas/costo y resultados contra todos los baselines; separar validez del run de promoción.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current log_valid accepts runs without params or experiment identity and does not execute promotion.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Aplicar group CV por entidad con disyunción train/valid y leer n_groups / mean de folds
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Construir y ejecutar CV apropiada a la dependencia: ajustar preprocessing+modelo dentro de cada fold, impedir overlap de todos los endpoints relevantes, registrar soporte por fold y complementar con validación temporal cuando corresponda; derivar análisis de errores de predicciones reales.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current code receives precomputed scores and checks only one artificial fold.

theory_code_output.title: framing.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: Returns unit,target,horizon,fraud_name and prints prevalence from y; no rejection/allowlist/horizon consistency/maturity checks.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Replace with validated TaskSpec + binary-label support + target/horizon parser + label-maturity check and pytest adversarial cases.
theory_code_output.justification: The prose fail-closed framing is not implemented.

theory_code_output.title: baseline.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: Computes majority from the same y it scores, cost only for dummy, rule threshold supplied by caller, prints has_baseline=True.
theory_code_output.improved_content: fit_dummy(y_train) -> frozen class; freeze/version rule on train/prior policy; evaluate both on y_valid with identical accuracy/cost and explicit tie policy.
theory_code_output.justification: Canonical baseline leaks holdout labels and cannot support the headline honest comparison.

theory_code_output.title: logistic.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: Calculates sigmoid for fixed w/b, l2_sq and prints params penalty/C; no supervised fit.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Fit a real regularized logistic model using the pinned/current sklearn API inside the training pipeline; validate finite inputs/probabilities and evaluate frozen holdout predictions.
theory_code_output.justification: A sigmoid demo is not evidence of trained regularized logistic regression.

theory_code_output.title: coefs.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: Ranks a supplied coefficient dict; scaled=True/causal=False are literals; returns sign of top coefficient while output labels it sign_shared_phone.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Generate coefficient table from fitted model joined to feature names and scale provenance; one sign per feature and model/fold/feature-set ids.
theory_code_output.justification: Interpretability safeguards are detached from fitted artifacts.

theory_code_output.title: red_diminuta.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: Trains tanh and no-activation XOR nets sequentially from one advancing RNG, so initial weights differ.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Move to optional appendix and clone identical initial parameters for the activation ablation; label it mechanics-only, not S33 gate evidence.
theory_code_output.justification: Current ablation changes activation and initialization simultaneously and consumes curriculum budget outside the roadmap.

theory_code_output.title: stump.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: Applies supplied threshold/votes and prints depth_unlimited=False; empty vote returns 1; no tree/RF/boosting is fit.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Fit/select a stump on train, reject empty ensemble input, read max_depth from estimator and add minimal RF/boosting candidates evaluated on the common holdout.
theory_code_output.justification: The current block demonstrates thresholding, not supervised tree/ensemble training.

theory_code_output.title: overfit.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: Checks a supplied train-valid gap and reseeds global random; does not compare depth candidates.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Use local RNG; evaluate a predeclared depth grid on validation/CV, log per-candidate train/valid/cost and freeze selected config before test.
theory_code_output.justification: Current code detects one supplied gap but does not perform the depth-control process described.

theory_code_output.title: tracking.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: Sorts arbitrary metrics, computes beats_dummy accuracy and accepts a run with nonempty metrics/run_id/bool; no Pipeline, params validation or promotion gate.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Build full Pipeline bound to S32 manifest; require immutable run manifest; separate validate_run from promotion_decision against best baseline/cost.
theory_code_output.justification: The block titled Pipeline has no pipeline and the run contract is too weak to reproduce the experiment.

theory_code_output.title: group_cv.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: Averages precomputed fold scores, counts entity ids and checks one handcrafted fold; random_leak_ok=False is literal.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Generate all folds from X/y/groups; ensure no relevant pair endpoint crosses folds; fit full preprocessing+model inside each train fold; predict valid; store support and error rows.
theory_code_output.justification: Precomputed scores plus one set-disjoint check are not cross-validation.

theory_code_output.title: origen_movil.py
theory_code_output.current_behavior: Switches to workload forecasting; compares seasonal baseline to 'yesterday' where later holdout predictions use actual values inside the same validation horizon; no S33 candidate.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Prefer rolling-origin validation on the same needs_review classification task. If forecasting remains optional, fix one information protocol and ensure every baseline/candidate receives exactly the same origin-available data.
theory_code_output.justification: Current 1.10 vs 3.86 comparison mixes different information sets and does not evaluate the S33 model.

callouts.current_content: Sin baseline documentado no se promociona modelo... Un run con beats_dummy=False se loguea igual.
callouts.improved_content: Sin dummy train-fit + regla versionada y un gate válido contra el mejor baseline/costo no hay promoción. Un run perdedor se registra igual.
callouts.justification: Beating dummy is not enough when the rule is stronger.

callouts.improved_content: Valida TaskSpec, target/horizon consistency, label provenance and maturity; reject invalid framing and request missing evidence.
callouts.justification: Current code does not enforce the callout.

callouts.current_content: Calcula majority con max(set(y), key=y.count), deriva el costo...
callouts.improved_content: Fit majority on train with explicit deterministic tie policy; freeze rule threshold before holdout; compute identical cost for every baseline/candidate.
callouts.justification: The prescribed majority implementation leaks and its tie claim is false.

callouts.current_content: Implementa sigmoid... Declara penalty="l2" y C...
callouts.improved_content: Fit the actual regularized estimator using a pinned/current API, log fitted config, validate finite probabilities and distinguish function demo from model evidence.
callouts.justification: Declaring a param string is not regularized training.

callouts.current_content: Rankea por |coef| solo con scaled=True y causal=False...
callouts.improved_content: Require verified feature-scale provenance joined to each coefficient; never accept handwritten scale/causal flags as model evidence.
callouts.justification: Current flags do not validate the fitted feature/model artifacts.

callouts.current_content: Parámetros, cálculo hacia adelante, pérdida, gradiente, paso...
callouts.improved_content: Mark as optional extension after S33 gate; carry mechanics forward without generic claims about which tabular model usually wins.
callouts.justification: Useful intuition is misplaced relative to incomplete required competencies.

callouts.improved_content: Validate fitted estimator max_depth, reject empty ensembles, and include actual RF/boosting candidates required by the roadmap.
callouts.justification: Current safety flag is literal and no tree is trained.

callouts.current_content: Umbral de gap de lab: 0.2... fija seed...
callouts.improved_content: Treat gap as diagnostic; log seed plus full experiment identity and show validation evidence for selected complexity.
callouts.justification: Seed/gap alone do not prove reproducibility or depth selection.

callouts.improved_content: Require complete run manifest and separate logging validity from best-baseline/cost promotion decision.
callouts.justification: Current minimum log is not reproducible and no promotion gate exists.

callouts.improved_content: Validate every fold, all relevant endpoints/groups and fit the complete pipeline within each training fold.
callouts.justification: One handcrafted fold does not establish group CV.

callouts.current_content: Entidades compartidas → group CV. Orden temporal → origen móvil... Baseline y candidato se comparan sobre los mismos folds...
callouts.improved_content: Choose split by dependency, but also equalize the information set: feature availability, label maturity and group constraints must hold; baseline and actual S33 candidate must be scored on the same folds/origins.
callouts.justification: The current code violates its own equal-fold/equal-information statement.

figures.current_content: Caption: Con esa brecha, el modelo memorizó... Alt: Tres barras: train, test y baseline.
figures.improved_content: Move to T3-B. Caption: 'Una brecha train–valid grande es una señal de posible sobreajuste; compárala junto al baseline.' Alt: 'Barras de train, validación y mejor baseline sobre la misma métrica.'
figures.justification: Overfit is premature in T1-A and test/valid terminology drifts.

figures.current_content: Three bars: majority class, logistic regression, complex model.
figures.improved_content: Four bars on one metric/cost scale: dummy majority, simple rule, logistic candidate and more complex candidate; highlight best simple baseline.
figures.justification: The mandatory rule baseline is absent from the visual model.
